headline: 8 Michigan deals, $27.4M raised — led by Green Meadow Partners, LLC

top_deals.summary: Green Meadow Partners, LLC, a Southfield-based commercial real estate company, filed an indefinite-size equity offering under Rule 506(b); $19.9M sold to 31 investors.
Modal Motors Inc., a Farmington Hills-based technology company, filed a $5M equity and other securities offering under Rule 506(b); $1.7M sold to 8 investors.

top_deals.company: Northern Shore Capital Coffee Investors Co-Invest LP
top_deals.summary: Northern Shore Capital Coffee Investors Co-Invest LP, a Bloomfield Hills-based private equity fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $3.5M sold to 3 investors. (Amended filing.)
Modal Motors Inc., a Farmington Hills-based technology company, filed a $3M equity and other securities offering under Rule 506(b); $1M sold to 1 investor.
cultivate-Nanochon Sidecar II, LLC, a Grand Rapids-based investment company, filed a $1.4M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $1.4M sold to 13 investors.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $27.4M sold across 5 Form D filings this week, down 59% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Green Meadow Partners, LLC (Southfield, Commercial) targeting $19.9M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

1 Michigan-based pooled fund filed Form Ds, reporting $3.5M raised so far — led by Northern Shore Capital Coffee Investors Co-Invest LP (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
Manufacturing & Automotive was the most active sector with 3 of 8 filings (38%). Ask contacts what's driving the activity, and whether it's showing up in their pipeline.
